prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Create Esk's neutral model turnaround as one horizontal 3:1 sheet, three equal square cells: front, side facing right, back. Same character, scale and colours in all three. Each stands 2.5 heads tall, sturdy round body, straight hanging mitten arms, straight legs, big boots; silhouette height 78% of cell, soles at 95% cell height. Tall pointed slate-blue hood #3e5566 tip flops forward, grey wolf-fur ruff #8f8476 scalloped simple outline, brass #b08d4a mining goggles pushed onto hood, amber lenses. Three dark-brown chunky fringe locks. Light skin #e8b996; small dark oval eyes with tiny square catchlight, low determined brows, tiny nose, short mouth. Slate blue hip-length parka, two wooden toggles, rope belt with empty hammer loop, near elbow leather patch. Rust red #b23a2e scarf wrapped twice with tail behind. Brown #70553a trousers, one square knee patch, dark #3a2a20 boots with fur cuffs. Coat ends at 79% cell height leaving legs visible down to 95%. No tools. True transparent background. Desired final sheet 960x320; generate larger for clean downsampling.
